FinRank targets this provenance-sensitive retrieval problem by requiring systems to identify evidence for the intended entity, reporting period, and disclosure context. The benchmark contains 1185 manually authored question-answer records over the 10-K and 10-Q filings of 22 companies. Each record includes a reference answer, gold supporting passages, and hand-curated hard negatives drawn from confusable passages within filings, across reporting periods, and across comparable firms. FinRank evaluates passage retrieval, reranking, and hard-negative discrimination as separately measured tasks. Baseline results demonstrate the difficulty of this setting: among the evaluated systems, even a 7B instruction-tuned embedder reaches only 44.8% Recall@10 on the pooled evidence corpus; sub-billion-parameter encoders gain at most 3.5 points over BM25, a finance-adapted embedder trails BM25 by 9.7 points, and pairwise accuracy falls by 13.0-20.5 percentage points when random negatives are replaced with the curated hard negatives. FinRank provides an evidence-first benchmark for developing financial question answering systems that are not only accurate but also grounded in the correct disclosure.
papers.title_zh: FinRank：针对 SEC 文件的财务问答和检索的循证基准
papers.abstract_zh: 财务问题回答通常通过答案的正确性来评估，但在美国证券交易委员会的文件中，看似合理甚至数字上正确的答案可能基于错误的证据。类似的事实和披露在文件的各个部分、同一家公司的报告期以及可比较的公司中反复出现。 FinRank 通过要求系统识别预期实体、报告期间和披露背景的证据来解决这一来源敏感的检索问题。该基准包含 22 家公司的 10-K 和 10-Q 文件中的 1185 条手动编写的问答记录。每条记录都包括参考答案、黄金支持段落，以及从文件中、跨报告期间和可比公司中的易混淆段落中精心挑选的严格否定。 FinRank 将段落检索、重新排序和硬阴性判别作为单独测量的任务进行评估。基线结果证明了这种设置的难度：在评估的系统中，即使是 7B 指令调整的嵌入器，在汇集的证据语料库上也只能达到 44.8% Recall@10；低于 10 亿个参数的编码器最多比 BM25 提高 3.5 个百分点，金融适应的嵌入器比 BM25 落后 9.7 个百分点，当随​​机负数被替换为精选的硬负数时，成对精度会下降 13.0-20.5 个百分点。 FinRank 为开发财务问答系统提供了证据优先的基准，该系统不仅准确，而且基于正确的披露。

papers.title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Tokens: How Vision Language Models Cut AI Energy Costs While Improving Accuracy
papers.abstract: LLM inference accounts for over 90% of AI operational energy, scaling directly with input token count---a critical inefficiency for telecom network analytics and numerical time-series data analysis (NTSDA), where raw multivariate KPI windows from 4G/5G cell sites expand into thousands of floating-point tokens. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) eliminate this mismatch by encoding time-series as 2D plots, achieving 3.6-10.4x input token reduction across Llama-3.2-90B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B, and Pixtral-12B architectures. This translates to 1.8-2.5x measured inference energy reduction, saving approximately 7.2 MJ/day at telecom edge deployments and CloudRAN that monitor 200 cells per 15-minute interval. Critically, efficiency gains do not sacrifice accuracy: a fine-tuned Llama-3.2-90B-Vision VLM achieves 220.7% higher precision than its text-only counterpart and outperforms LSTM and ARIMA baselines by over 144% on telecom anomaly detection. On public benchmarks, Pixtral-12B achieves a 20.6x improvement in J/F1 score at mean F1 = 0.82. At 24 KPIs, text representations exceed the 128K context window of most production LLMs, rendering text-only processing infeasible without truncation, while visual representations remain within standard limits. These results establish VLMs as an energy-efficient and accuracy-superior modality for numerical time-series workloads, providing empirical grounding for AI inference systems that treat energy consumption as a first-class engineering constraint.
papers.title_zh: 一张图片值一千个代币：视觉语言模型如何在提高准确性的同时降低人工智能能源成本
papers.abstract_zh: LLM 推理占 AI 操作能量的 90% 以上，直接随输入令牌数量扩展——这对于电信网络分析和数值时间序列数据分析 (NTSDA) 来说是一个严重的低效问题，其中来自 4G/5G 蜂窝站点的原始多元 KPI 窗口扩展到数千个浮点令牌。视觉语言模型 (VLM) 通过将时间序列编码为 2D 图来消除这种不匹配，在 Llama-3.2-90B、Qwen2.5-VL-72B 和 Pixtral-12B 架构中实现 3.6-10.4 倍的输入标记减少。这意味着测得的推理能量减少了 1.8-2.5 倍，在每 15 分钟间隔监控 200 个小区的电信边缘部署和 CloudRAN 中，每天可节省约 7.2 MJ。至关重要的是，效率的提升并不会牺牲准确性：经过微调的 Llama-3.2-90B-Vision VLM 的精度比纯文本版本高 220.7%，并且在电信异常检测方面比 LSTM 和 ARIMA 基线高出 144% 以上。在公共基准测试中，Pixtral-12B 在平均 F1 = 0.82 时 J/F1 得分提高了 20.6 倍。在 24 个 KPI 下，文本表示超出了大多数生产法学硕士的 128K 上下文窗口，导致纯文本处理在不截断的情况下不可行，而视觉表示仍保持在标准限制内。这些结果将 VLM 确立为数值时间序列工作负载的一种节能且准确度优越的模式，为将能耗视为一流工程约束的人工智能推理系统提供了经验基础。

papers.title: SCALE: Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings for Fine-Grained Taxonomy Extension
papers.abstract: The increasing specialization of scientific research challenges existing classification systems, which provide effective representations of broad disciplines and research topics but often fail to capture the fine-grained conceptual structure of contemporary science. Author keywords offer greater specificity, but their fragmentation, redundancy, and terminological variability limit their use as stable units of knowledge organization. We introduce SCALE (Scientific Concept Aggregation via LLMs and Embeddings), a framework that extends the OpenAlex taxonomy with a new level of scientific Concepts below Topics. Rather than treating keywords as isolated descriptors, SCALE organizes semantically related terms into coherent and interpretable conceptual units and integrates them within the existing disciplinary hierarchy. The framework combines scientific text embeddings, large language models, and graph-based community detection to construct this additional layer at scale. The resulting taxonomy enables scientific literature to be read through an intermediate conceptual level between broad research topics and individual documents. This perspective provides a more detailed representation of how scientific knowledge is structured, specialized, and connected across disciplines. By transforming heterogeneous author terminology into reusable hierarchical units, SCALE offers a foundation for fine-grained scholarly classification, scientometric analysis, research monitoring, and future ontology development.
papers.title_zh: SCALE：通过法学硕士和嵌入进行科学概念聚合，以实现细粒度分类法扩展
papers.abstract_zh: 科学研究的日益专业化对现有的分类系统提出了挑战，现有的分类系统提供了广泛学科和研究主题的有效表示，但往往无法捕捉当代科学的细粒度概念结构。作者关键词提供了更大的特异性，但它们的碎片化、冗余性和术语可变性限制了它们作为知识组织的稳定单元的使用。我们引入了 SCALE（通过法学硕士和嵌入进行的科学概念聚合），这是一个框架，它通过主题下面的科学概念达到新的水平来扩展 OpenAlex 分类法。 SCALE 没有将关键字视为孤立的描述符，而是将语义相关的术语组织成连贯且可解释的概念单元，并将它们集成到现有的学科层次结构中。该框架结合了科学文本嵌入、大型语言模型和基于图的社区检测来大规模构建这个附加层。由此产生的分类法使科学文献能够通过广泛的研究主题和单个文档之间的中间概念水平来阅读。这种观点更详细地描述了科学知识是如何构建、专业化以及跨学科联系的。通过将异构作者术语转化为可重用的分层单元，SCALE 为细粒度学术分类、科学计量分析、研究监控和未来本体论开发奠定了基础。

papers.title: From probability to causality in probabilistic logic programming
papers.abstract: Probabilistic logic programming is a formalism of statistical relational artificial intelligence that supports causal queries, including interventions from outside the system. When the structure of a probabilistic logic program is learned from data, however, only probabilistic information is used, and a single probability distribution may be compatible with several causal orders. This leads to ambiguity in interventional reasoning, raising the question of when the causal order is uniquely determined by the distribution. Exploiting the relationship between acyclic probabilistic logic programs and Bayesian networks, we derive conditions under which the probabilistic information encoded in a program determines a unique causal order. We also incorporate constraints arising from relational structure by taking into account prescribed sets of causal symmetries induced by the underlying relational vocabulary. The result is a method for verifying when a learned probabilistic logic program supports well-defined intervention semantics.
papers.title_zh: 概率逻辑编程中从概率到因果关系
papers.abstract_zh: 概率逻辑编程是统计关系人工智能的一种形式主义，支持因果查询，包括来自系统外部的干预。然而，当从数据中学习概率逻辑程序的结构时，仅使用概率信息，并且单个概率分布可以与多个因果顺序兼容。这导致介入推理的模糊性，提出了因果顺序何时由分布唯一确定的问题。利用非循环概率逻辑程序和贝叶斯网络之间的关系，我们推导出程序​​中编码的概率信息确定唯一因果顺序的条件。我们还通过考虑由底层关系词汇引起的规定的因果对称集来合并由关系结构产生的约束。结果是一种验证学习的概率逻辑程序何时支持明确定义的干预语义的方法。

papers.title: EliSeg: Verified Target Construction for Report-Grounded Abnormality Segmentation
papers.abstract: Radiology reports describe clinical observations but do not specify executable segmentation targets. They may contain present, negated, prior,uncertain, or irrelevant findings, while multiple valid abnormalities may coexist. Existing segmentation methods largely bypass this ambiguity by receiving a target identity or spatial prompt before inference, which acts as a hidden target oracle. We study report-grounded abnormality segmentation, where a model must determine target eligibility, cardinality, and finding-to-mask correspondence directly from an unfiltered report before delineating the corresponding regions. We propose \textbf{EliSeg}, an atcor--verify--revise framework that integrates target construction with mask generation. A grammar-constrained Actor proposes target slots and masks, an independent text-only Verifier reconstructs the eligible finding inventory, and Revision selectively re-executes the shared Actor when their target structures disagree. EliSeg requires no predefined target identity, finding prompt, point, or bounding box. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR-ILS show that EliSeg consistently outperforms direct segmentation methods and extract-then-segment cascades across findings, while effectively suppressing masks for ineligible report mentions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of verification and revision, and evaluation on CheXlocalize demonstrates effective transfer of the EliSeg to an external dataset.Code is available at https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg.
papers.title_zh: EliSeg：基于报告的异常分割的经过验证的目标构建
papers.abstract_zh: 放射学报告描述了临床观察结果，但没有指定可执行的分割目标。它们可能包含当前的、否定的、先前的、不确定的或不相关的发现，而多种有效的异常可能共存。现有的分割方法在很大程度上通过在推理之前接收目标身份或空间提示来绕过这种歧义，这充当了隐藏的目标预言机。我们研究基于报告的异常分割，其中模型必须直接从未经过滤的报告中确定目标资格、基数和发现与掩码的对应关系，然后再描绘相应的区域。我们提出 \textbf{EliSeg}，一个将目标构建与掩码生成集成在一起的 atcor--verify--revise 框架。语法约束的 Actor 提出目标槽和掩码，独立的纯文本验证器重建符合条件的发现清单，并且当目标结构不一致时，Revision 有选择地重新执行共享 Actor。 EliSeg 不需要预定义的目标标识、查找提示、点或边界框。 MIMIC-CXR-ILS 上的实验表明，EliSeg 始终优于直接分割方法和跨结果提取然后分割级联，同时有效抑制不合格报告提及的屏蔽。消融研究证实了验证和修订的互补作用，对 CheXlocalize 的评估证明了 EliSeg 到外部数据集的有效传输。代码可在 https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg 获取。

papers.title: Blast Radius
papers.abstract: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for retention, recurrence, and eviction while connecting context entropy to resurrection probability. Across seven OpenAI models, Blast Radius reduced token consumption by 17-26%, achieved the lowest overflow rate among tested policies, and remained byte exact reversible. Of 450 buried bodies, 378 were recurring dead matter and zero were recalled. Blast Radius operates beneath HCRC, determining which records to bury and how far an incoming prompt may reach into the codebase. This work contributes to the broader goal of Algosophy: making large language models and agentic coding more reusable and sustainable.
papers.title_zh: 爆炸半径
papers.abstract_zh: 代理编码面临着日益严重的负担能力和浪费代币的问题。我们引入了 Blast Radius，这是一个预测内存管理层，可通过耦合的上下文和代码通道来估计传入提示的范围。尸检通过逐字归档死亡上下文来实现可逆驱逐，而重复死亡物质 (RDM) 则可以识别并埋葬重复出现的转录本。我们在波兰上下文空间上制定了可逆上下文驱逐，为保留、重复和驱逐提供了可测量的基础，同时将上下文熵与复活概率联系起来。在七个 OpenAI 模型中，Blast Radius 将代币消耗减少了 17-26%，在测试的策略中实现了最低的溢出率，并且保持字节精确可逆。在 450 具掩埋尸体中，有 378 具重复出现的死亡物质，其中 0 具被召回。 Blast Radius 在 HCRC 下运行，确定要隐藏哪些记录以及传入提示可以到达代码库的深度。这项工作有助于实现算法学的更广泛目标：使大型语言模型和代理编码更加可重用和可持续。

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and DanceGRPO-based closed-loop policy optimization. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. On a fixed near-goal evaluation set, WNM-3D also achieves higher flow-action consistency and lower visual-motion error.
papers.title_zh: WNM-3D：具有闭环 VLN 3D 场景调节功能的世界导航模型
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的视觉语言导航（VLN）系统越来越多地将预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）融入视觉语言动作（VLA）策略中，这些策略将自我中心的观察和语言指令直接映射到导航动作。尽管在语义上具有能力，但这种以动作为中心的训练并没有明确地模拟智能体的视觉观察在其预测运动下应如何演变。生成式世界动作模型 (WAM) 共同预测未来的观察和动作，但现有的连续 VLN 的 WAM 并不以从观察到的历史推断出的几何感知表示为条件，联合生成未来视图和动作。我们推出了 WNM-3D，这是一种生成式世界导航模型，具有用于连续 VLN 的 3D 场景调节功能。为了将过去的观察结果整合到持久的场景上下文中，冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目自我中心 RGB 历史中提取几何感知表示，并且可训练的 3D 场景到令牌适配器将它们转换为世界动作扩散变压器令牌空间中的固定长度前缀。通过块因果注意力，这个前缀限制了每个未来的视频动作块，为未来视图和动作生成提供了共享的几何上下文。我们通过对 A* 生成的演示进行有监督的世界动作微调、对政策访问状态进行 DAgger 式适应以及基于 DanceGRPO 的闭环政策优化来训练 WNM-3D。 GN-Bench 上的实验表明，WNM-3D 在闭环导航中的性能优于基于 VLM 的强大导航策略及其 2D 条件对应策略。在固定的近目标评估集上，WNM-3D 还实现了更高的流动动作一致性和更低的视觉运动误差。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Can Match Domain Experts in Evidence Extraction and Critical Appraisal of Microbial Oncogenesis Research Publications
papers.abstract: Confirmed oncogenic microbes contribute significantly to cancer burden. Identifying novel microbial oncogenicity could yield strategies that will reduce disease burdens. However, relevant evidence is dispersed and infeasible for humans to comprehensively synthesize. LLMs may enable scalable, expert-level systematic evidence synthesis to identify microbe-cancer pairs; however, such capabilities have not yet been demonstrated. Domain experts were recruited to create a dataset to benchmark LLM performance (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5, GPT-5 Nano) on 24 research papers using MMTV-LV and breast cancer as a case study. We devised a structured template for evidence extraction and appraisal, consisting of MCQ, Likert-scale, multi-select, and free-text question types (77 items across 24 papers). Agreement between (1) experts and (2) experts and each LLM was determined per question instance using novel metrics. LLMs were assessed by comparing inter-expert and expert-LLM agreement distributions to determine whether LLMs behaved as additional experts by increasing or maintaining inter-expert agreement. Free-text responses were further evaluated qualitatively. Across all question types, LLM responses aligned closely with experts, with GPT-5 and GPT-5 Nano achieving score distributions indistinguishable from experts. Gemini models behaved similarly but were significantly more lenient in applying microbial oncogenesis criteria. Hallucinations were rare. Methodological appraisal and identification of contradictions within full-texts were the most persistent LLM vulnerabilities. GPT-5 and GPT-5 Nano were indistinguishable from experts on structured domain research paper evaluation tasks. This supports use of LLMs for automated systematic evidence synthesis. However, methodological appraisal tasks and contradiction identification in full-texts remain weaknesses requiring strengthening.
papers.title_zh: 人工智能可以在微生物肿瘤发生研究出版物的证据提取和批判性评估方面与领域专家相匹配
papers.abstract_zh: 已证实的致癌微生物对癌症负担有显着贡献。识别新的微生物致癌性可以产生减少疾病负担的策略。但相关证据比较分散，人类无法全面综合。法学硕士可以实现可扩展的、专家级的系统证据合成，以识别微生物-癌症对；然而，这种能力尚未得到证实。招募了领域专家来创建一个数据集，以使用 MMTV-LV 和乳腺癌作为案例研究，对 24 篇研究论文的 LLM 性能（Gemini 2.5 Pro、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5、GPT-5 Nano）进行基准测试。我们设计了一个用于证据提取和评估的结构化模板，包括 MCQ、李克特量表、多选和自由文本问题类型（24 篇论文中的 77 个项目）。 (1) 专家和 (2) 专家与每个法学硕士之间的协议是使用新颖的指标针对每个问题实例确定的。通过比较专家间和专家与法学硕士的一致性分布来评估法学硕士，以确定法学硕士是否通过增加或维持专家间一致性来充当额外的专家。对自由文本回复进行了进一步的定性评估。在所有问题类型中，LLM 的回答与专家密切一致，GPT-5 和 GPT-5 Nano 的分数分布与专家没有区别。双子座模型表现相似，但在应用微生物肿瘤发生标准时明显更加宽松。幻觉很少见。方法论评估和全文矛盾识别是法学硕士最持久的弱点。 GPT-5 和 GPT-5 Nano 与结构化领域研究论文评估任务的专家没有什么区别。这支持使用法学硕士进行自动化系统证据合成。但全文的方法评价任务和矛盾识别仍然是需要加强的薄弱环节。

papers.title: Reading Copom's Tone: A Weighted LLM Framework for Hawkish-Dovish Sentiment, Forward Guidance, and Uncertainty
papers.abstract: This paper documents an applied natural-language-processing framework for measuring the tone of Brazilian Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) statements. The project is explicitly inspired by iSent, Itaú's Central Bank sentiment classifier, particularly its sentence-level division of official communication into hawkish, dovish, neutral, and out-of-context classes. The implementation extends that idea in three directions. First, an LLM identifies short hawkish and dovish expressions and assigns each a 0-to-1 intensity weight. Second, the document index combines sentence counts with document-specific average signal intensities, producing a bounded score from -1 to 1. Third, a separate full-document layer measures forward-guidance direction, guidance explicitness, uncertainty level, and change in uncertainty. The empirical sample is restricted to communications dated August 2016 or later and contains 80 statements and 1,498 classified sentences from August 31, 2016 through August 5, 2026. Across this sample, 33.3% of sentences are hawkish, 18.0% dovish, 42.1% neutral, and 6.5% out of context. The average document score is +0.107, while the most hawkish reading is +0.570 in August 2021. The latest statement, dated August 5, 2026, scores +0.232, with eight hawkish, two dovish, and nine neutral sentences. Its structural overlay is more nuanced: guidance is directionally ambiguous but partly explicit, while uncertainty is classified as central and higher than at the prior meeting. Tone and the guidance-direction score have a contemporaneous Pearson correlation of 0.719. These are descriptive outputs, not a validated forecast of Selic decisions or DI returns. The main contribution is therefore methodological: a transparent, incremental, auditable system that separates rhetorical tone from policy guidance and uncertainty.
papers.title_zh: 解读 Copom 的语气：鹰派-鸽派情绪、前瞻性指导和不确定性的加权法学硕士框架
papers.abstract_zh: 本文记录了一个应用自然语言处理框架，用于衡量巴西货币政策委员会 (Copom) 声明的语气。该项目明显受到 Itaú 中央银行情绪分类器 iSent 的启发，特别是其将官方沟通的句子级别划分为鹰派、鸽派、中立和断章取义的类别。该实施将这一想法扩展到三个方向。首先，法学硕士会识别简短的鹰派和鸽派表达，并为每个表达分配一个 0 到 1 的强度权重。其次，文档索引将句子计数与特定于文档的平均信号强度相结合，产生从 -1 到 1 的有界分数。第三，单独的全文档层测量前向指导方向、指导明确性、不确定性水平和不确定性变化。实证样本仅限于 2016 年 8 月或之后的通信，包含 2016 年 8 月 31 日至 2026 年 8 月 5 日期间的 80 条陈述和 1,498 个分类句子。在该样本中，33.3% 的句子是鹰派的，18.0% 是鸽派的，42.1% 是中立的，6.5% 是断章取义的。平均文档得分为 +0.107，而 2021 年 8 月的最强鹰派读数为 +0.570。2026 年 8 月 5 日的最新声明得分为 +0.232，其中有 8 个鹰派句子、2 个鸽派句子和 9 个中性句子。其结构覆盖更加微妙：指导方向模糊但部分明确，而不确定性被列为核心，并且比之前的会议更高。语气和指导方向得分的同期 Pearson 相关性为 0.719。这些是描述性输出，而不是经过验证的 Selic 决策或 DI 返回的预测。因此，主要的贡献是方法论上的：一个透明的、渐进的、可审计的系统，将修辞语气与政策指导和不确定性分开。

papers.title: A Finite E-Group of Nilpotency Class Three
papers.abstract: A group is an E-group if every element commutes with each of its endomorphic images. Caranti asked whether a finite E-group can have nilpotency class three. We prove that the $3$-group of order $3^{84}$ introduced by Abdollahi, Faghihi, and Mohammadi Hassanabadi, and later shown by Abdollahi, Faghihi, Linton, and O'Brien to have the corresponding automorphism property, is an E-group. Let $P$ denote this group and put $V=P/Φ(P)\cong \mathbb{F}_3^9$. The nine power relations of $P$ determine a linear map $q:V\longrightarrowΛ^2 V$. We prove that $q$ has no nonzero proper subspace $U$ satisfying $q(U)\subseteqΛ^2 U$. Since the image induced by any endomorphism of $P$ on $V$ has precisely this closure property, every endomorphism acts on $V$ either invertibly or trivially. The invertible case is the known A-group case. In the trivial case the image first lies in $Φ(P)=P'$, and the power relations then force it into $Ω_1(P')=Z(P)$. Thus every element commutes with every endomorphic image. The tensor rigidity is reduced to an exact finite calculation on the $9841$ points of $\mathrm{PG}(8,3)$.
papers.title_zh: 三级幂幂的有限E群
papers.abstract_zh: 如果一个群的每个元素都与其每个内态图像交换，那么该群就是 E 群。卡兰蒂询问有限 E 群是否可以具有三级幂零性。我们证明由 Abdollahi、Faghihi 和 Mohammadi Hassanabadi 引入、后来由 Abdollahi、Faghihi、Linton 和 O'Brien 证明具有相应自同构性质的 $3^{84}$ 阶 $3$ 群是一个 E 群。令 $P$ 表示该群并输入 $V=P/Φ(P)\cong \mathbb{F}_3^9$。 $P$ 的九次幂关系确定了一个线性映射 $q:V\longrightarrowΛ^2 V$。我们证明$q$不存在满足$q(U)\subseteqΛ^2 U$的非零真子空间$U$。由于 $P$ 在 $V$ 上的任何自同态所引起的图像恰好具有这种闭包性质，因此每个自同态都可逆地或平凡地作用于 $V$。可逆的情况是已知的 A 组情况。在平凡的情况下，图像首先位于$Φ(P)=P'$，然后幂关系迫使其变为$Ω_1(P')=Z(P)$。因此，每个元素都与每个内态图像交换。张量刚度被简化为 $\mathrm{PG}(8,3)$ 的 $9841$ 点上的精确有限计算。

papers.title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretable Models of Human Randomisation Failures
papers.abstract: Mixed strategy equilibrium predicts i.i.d play: past actions should not help predict future decisions. Human players, however, systematically depart from this benchmark, and in O'Neill's zero sum card game, these departures can be predicted by black box sequence models such as LSTMs. This paper asks whether that predictive power can be achieved by transparent alternatives that also reveal the behavioural structure behind it. Using 84,060 decisions from 2,802 pairs, the analysis first benchmarks naive and behavioral models against interpretable machine learning and deep learning models, then evaluates the modified EWA specifications of prior work against these benchmarks and uses the LASSO diagnostics to motivate a further nested frequency tracking extension. The results show that repeat or avoid behavior, especially players' management of their own recent action histories, accounts for most of the interpretable and strategically exploitable signal, while frequency tracking adds little out of sample.
papers.title_zh: 超越黑匣子：人类随机化失败的可解释模型
papers.abstract_zh: 混合策略均衡预测独立同分布：过去的行动不应有助于预测未来的决策。然而，人类玩家系统地偏离了这一基准，并且在奥尼尔的零和纸牌游戏中，这些偏离可以通过 LSTM 等黑盒序列模型来预测。本文询问这种预测能力是否可以通过透明的替代方案来实现，同时也揭示其背后的行为结构。该分析使用 2,802 对中的 84,060 个决策，首先根据可解释的机器学习和深度学习模型对朴素模型和行为模型进行基准测试，然后根据这些基准评估先前工作的修改后的 EWA 规范，并使用 LASSO 诊断来激发进一步的嵌套频率跟踪扩展。结果表明，重复或避免行为，尤其是玩家对自己最近的行为历史的管理，解释了大部分可解释和可战略利用的信号，而频率跟踪几乎没有增加样本。

papers.title: Toward a Causal Data Management Ecosystem for Decision Making and Agentic AI
papers.abstract: Modern AI is no longer a single model but an ecosystem: classical ML predictors, deep and multimodal models, large language models, and agents, each trained and tuned over different data sources and each producing outputs at scale that become inputs to the others. Operating such an ecosystem is fundamentally a data integration problem - the knowledge it depends on is fragmented across dozens of heterogeneous, independently governed sources that must be reconciled and continually maintained. Yet integration alone is not enough. The predictions these systems make are shaped by many interacting factors, and the events, decisions, and variables that drive an outcome are routinely entangled with the ones that merely accompany it; treated as a basis for action, such correlational signals invite confounded decisions. This becomes acute once agents act autonomously: to be trustworthy and reliable, an agent must anticipate the consequences of its actions, not merely extrapolate from what has co-occurred before. Causal reasoning is what closes this gap, distinguishing the drivers of an outcome from its correlates, and enabling prescriptive and counterfactual analysis over the ecosystem's data. We therefore argue that the integrated ecosystem needs an explicit causal layer, and we propose to build it as a shared, persistent, queryable Causal World System (CWS).
papers.title_zh: 面向决策和代理人工智能的因果数据管理生态系统
papers.abstract_zh: 现代人工智能不再是单一模型，而是一个生态系统：经典的机器学习预测器、深度和多模态模型、大型语言模型和代理，每个模型都根据不同的数据源进行训练和调整，并且每个模型都大规模地产生输出，这些输出可以成为其他模型的输入。运营这样一个生态系统从根本上来说是一个数据集成问题——它所依赖的知识分散在数十个异构的、独立管理的来源中，必须对这些来源进行协调和持续维护。然而，仅仅整合还不够。这些系统做出的预测是由许多相互作用的因素决定的，而驱动结果的事件、决策和变量通常与仅仅伴随结果的事件、决策和变量纠缠在一起；如果将此类相关信号视为行动的基础，则会导致令人困惑的决策。一旦智能体自主行动，这种情况就会变得尖锐：为了值得信赖和可靠，智能体必须预测其行为的后果，而不仅仅是根据之前同时发生的事情进行推断。因果推理可以缩小这一差距，将结果的驱动因素与其相关因素区分开来，并能够对生态系统的数据进行规范性和反事实分析。因此，我们认为综合生态系统需要一个明确的因果层，我们建议将其构建为一个共享的、持久的、可查询的因果世界系统（CWS）。

papers.title: Recipes for Creativity: Iterative Generation and Evaluation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Generative models are often evaluated through singular artifacts, whereas human creativity typically emerges through iterative generation, appraisal, and refinement. This pilot study examines whether iterative search improves LLM creativity by adapting FunSearch to recipe generation for the 2024 Pillsbury Bake-Off and evaluating outputs against human benchmarks using TTCT-based LLM evaluation. Across two experiments, we test iteration count, generator temperature, and in-loop selection-scorer model size. Results show that iterative generation-selection can produce recipes with creativity scores comparable to human benchmarks, but additional iterations alone do not improve creativity. The in-loop evaluator matters most: a smaller selection scorer yields significantly higher scores across most TTCT dimensions, while temperature has limited effects except for originality. These findings suggest that evaluator design is a first-order design variable in subjective creative search.
papers.title_zh: 创造力的秘诀：大型语言模型中的迭代生成和评估
papers.abstract_zh: 生成模型通常通过单一的工件进行评估，而人类的创造力通常通过迭代生成、评估和完善而出现。这项试点研究通过使 FunSearch 适应 2024 年 Pillsbury Bake-Off 的菜谱生成，并使用基于 TTCT 的法学硕士评估根据人类基准评估输出，检验迭代搜索是否可以提高法学硕士的创造力。在两个实验中，我们测试了迭代计数、生成器温度和循环选择评分器模型大小。结果表明，迭代一代选择可以产生创造力得分与人类基准相当的食谱，但单独的额外迭代并不能提高创造力。循环评估器最重要：较小的选择评分器在大多数 TTCT 维度上产生显着更高的分数，而除了原创性之外，温度的影响有限。这些发现表明，评估者设计是主观创意搜索中的一阶设计变量。

papers.title: TOFD: Target-Oriented Feature Decoupling against Poisoning Attacks in Split Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) facilitates privacy-preserving collaborative training with reduced client-side overhead. However, its split architecture introduces unique attack surfaces, rendering it vulnerable to diverse poisoning attacks. Most existing defenses fail to exploit the split paradigm, limiting their ability to detect and contain malicious behaviors at an early stage. To bridge this gap, we propose Target-Oriented Feature Decoupling (TOFD), a unified framework that jointly enables proactive detection and robust optimization against a wide range of poisoning attacks. TOFD operates in three stages: (1) Target Inference, which identifies potential attack targets by refining class-wise safe zones via class-specific Margin Perturbation (MP); (2) Sample Purification, which adaptively filters poisoned smashed data using thresholds calibrated through cross-class min-max normalization of MP; and (3) Decoupling Optimization, which leverages an adversarial guidance model to capture attack-induced patterns and decouple their influence during optimization, thereby suppressing residual adversarial effects. We provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of TOFD. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that TOFD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses under diverse attack scenarios, achieving superior robustness with low computational overhead suitable for practical deployment.
papers.title_zh: TOFD：分裂联邦学习中面向目标的特征解耦对抗中毒攻击
papers.abstract_zh: 分割联合学习 (SFL) 有助于保护隐私的协作训练，同时减少客户端开销。然而，其分离架构引入了独特的攻击面，使其容易受到各种中毒攻击。大多数现有的防御措施无法利用分裂范式，从而限制了它们在早期阶段检测和遏制恶意行为的能力。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了面向目标的特征解耦（TOFD），这是一个统一的框架，可以共同实现针对各种中毒攻击的主动检测和稳健优化。 TOFD 分三个阶段运行：(1) 目标推断，通过特定类的裕度扰动 (MP) 细化类安全区来识别潜在的攻击目标； (2)样本净化，使用通过MP的跨类最小-最大归一化校准的阈值自适应地过滤中毒的粉碎数据； （3）解耦优化，利用对抗性引导模型来捕获攻击引起的模式，并在优化过程中解耦其影响，从而抑制残余对抗效应。我们为TOFD的收敛性提供了理论保证。对五个数据集的广泛实验表明，TOFD 在不同的攻击场景下始终优于最先进的防御，以适合实际部署的低计算开销实现卓越的鲁棒性。
